text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CST, according to analysts.

CANOLA - steady to C$0.30 higher with anticipated gains in CBOT soybeans seen sparking light shortcovering. Dealers will watch closely to see if the major crusher who recently bought both March and November returns to market. The Canadian dollar opened softer at C$1.3375 and the yen cross rose to 88.83 yen.
FLAX - steady to $0.50 higher with strength of other oilseeds possibly helping spark early commercial buying.
WESTERN BARLEY - steady with February/March and February/May spread trade again expected to be the main feature.
FEED WHEAT - steady to C$0.50 up. May be some follow-through buying on the March contract early after a strong close Tuesday.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
